title: Sepsis Early Warning
summary: Synthetic-demo and local-research workflow for ICU deterioration-risk modeling with calibration and safety controls.
outcome: Release-pending portfolio project; only the synthetic surface is eligible for deployment.
metrics: AUROC, AUPRC, Brier score, and calibration are required before research-result claims
evaluation: Patient-level splits, leakage controls, calibration, subgroup analysis, and confidence intervals required
operationalTradeoffs: Clinical safety requires an explicit separation between research data and deployable synthetic demonstrations
disclaimer: Educational project only. It is not a clinical device and must not guide care.
